_note: Motes: the one currency outside a run. Bands are a printed tell for now, so a rarity system later changes this file and AdventureEconomy.band() and nothing else.
_slots_note: Deck slots and Aspect tiers are bought per starter and kept for good. The Nth slot costs slot_cost_base * slot_cost_growth^(N-1), rounded to slot_cost_round. A starter may buy slots until its deck reaches DeckValidator's maximum, so a 53-card starter has 32 to buy and the whole track costs 20110, about 41 full wins at 490 each.
